description: This file contains unit tests for the RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder class in the OFBiz framework, verifying the correct formation of macro call renderings for form elements, labels, links, and date range pickers.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilderTest
classes.description: This class contains JUnit test methods for testing the RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder's methods in rendering form elements as macro calls.

methods.name: emptyLabelUsesNoopMacro
methods.description: Tests that when label text is empty, the builder returns a no-op macro.

methods.name: labelMacroCallUsesText
methods.description: Verifies that a label with text generates a macro call with correct name and parameters.

methods.name: displayFieldMacroUsesType
methods.description: Ensures that display fields produce macro calls with the correct type parameter.

methods.name: containerMacroCallUsesContainerId
methods.description: Checks that container macro calls use the current container ID.

methods.name: basicAnchorLinkCreatesMacroCall
methods.description: Tests that hyperlink elements generate macro calls with correct attributes.

methods.name: textFieldSetsIdValueAndLength
methods.description: Verifies that text fields set id, value, and maxlength correctly.

methods.name: textFieldCreatesAjaxUrl
methods.description: Verifies generation of AJAX URL parameters in text fields.

methods.name: textFieldDefaultTypeIsText
methods.description: Checks default type of text fields is 'text'.

methods.name: textFieldTypeNumber
methods.description: Checks that type 'number' is handled correctly with 'step' set to 'any'.

methods.name: textFieldTypeNumberCustomStep
methods.description: Verifies custom step values are included for number type.

methods.name: textFieldTypeEmail
methods.description: Verifies type 'email' macro parameters.

methods.name: textFieldTypeUrl
methods.description: Verifies type 'url' macro parameters.

methods.name: textFieldTypeTel
methods.description: Verifies type 'tel' macro parameters.

methods.name: textFieldNotRequired
methods.description: Checks that non-required fields set 'required' parameter to false.

methods.name: textFieldRequiredWithoutRequiredStyle
methods.description: Ensures that required fields without style add 'required' class.

methods.name: textFieldRequiredWithRequiredStyle
methods.description: Ensures that required fields with style include style class.

methods.name: textFieldPattern
methods.description: Checks that pattern attribute is included correctly.

methods.name: textFieldPatternOnInvalidType
methods.description: Ensures pattern is not included for incompatible types, e.g., 'number'.

methods.name: textareaFieldSetsIdValueLengthAndSize
methods.description: Verifies textarea fields include id, value, cols, rows, maxlength.

methods.name: textareaFieldSetsDisabledParameters
methods.description: Checks disabled attribute is reflected in macro.

methods.name: textareaFieldVisualEditorEnabledNoButtons
methods.description: Tests visual editor enabled with no buttons.

methods.name: textareaFieldVisualEditorEnabledButtons
methods.description: Tests visual editor with configured buttons.

methods.name: fieldGroupOpenRendersCollapsibleAreaId
methods.description: Verifies correct rendering of a collapsible field group with ID and style.

methods.name: fieldGroupCloseRendersStyle
methods.description: Tests closing of field group with style.

methods.name: dateRangePickerField
methods.description: Verifies detailed parameters generated for date range picker fields.
